description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'askOpusApproval' that interacts with the OpenAI API to evaluate code autocomplete suggestions for approval or rejection based on specific criteria. It includes imports, constants, and logic for constructing prompts and handling API responses.

methods.name: askOpusApproval
methods.description: Evaluates autocomplete suggestions by prompting an AI model to approve, reject, or mark as uncertain based on code quality and relevance criteria.
